name: @emsenn/content-production
description: Content Production — content + computing: the content domain (@emsenn/content, the WHAT) run on the computer (@emsenn/computing, the HOW). Two modules: ./content-farm produces/enriches content (witnessed cultivation cycles — demand pull, story selection, drafting via ask, editorial gates, candidate projection, run trace, editorial work deposit, compost over withheld runs; each cycle a run on the computer with provenance articulating → predicating → positing → settling), and ./content-mill forms cultivated content for distribution (a publication's claim sets → feeds, sitemaps, robots, NewsArticle JSON-LD, h-entry bodies, ninjs, and the editorial-gate audit; web-free, returns strings/objects a site mounts on HTTP). Pure logic as scripts (./scripts), no transport — a generic server mounts the scripts over HTTP; koios.news is a parameterized server of this package. Absorbs the news/syndication family (newswire, newscable, newsroom) as that work folds in.

scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
